For over 5 years, Arthur has been professionally covering video games, writing guides and walkthroughs. His passion for video games began at age 10 in 2010 when he first played Gothic , an immersive classic that immediately hooked him on rich storytelling, open-world exploration, and character development. This early experience sparked a lifelong love for RPGs, leading him to dive deep into The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion and The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim , where he spent countless hours building characters, exploring vast fantasy worlds, and getting lost in epic narratives.
Over the years, his interests expanded into competitive multiplayer gaming. He has invested significant time in Counter-Strike (both older versions and CS:GO/CS2) for its intense tactical gameplay and Dota 2 for its strategic depth, team coordination, and ever-evolving meta. Gaming remains one of his greatest passions, combining creativity, problem-solving, and community, and it continues to influence his perspective as a guide writer.
